description: Press a decision you just made until you can explain it plainly to a skeptic, or until the gap you cannot explain is named out loud. Use right after committing to a design or an approach, or when the user says "feynman this", "explain this like I am new", or "do you actually understand this". It tests your own grasp of a decision. To teach a concept to the user, use explain-concept.
